PAINT WIZARDS 🧙🏼‍♂️ 🪄🎨🖌️— QUALITY YOU CAN TRUST
Paint Wizards is a family-owned, licensed and insured painting company proudly serving Grand Junction and the surrounding area. For the past two years, we’ve helped homeowners and businesses transform their spaces with professional interior and exterior painting.

While Paint Wizards has been in business for just two years, our painters bring 10+ years of hands-on painting experience to the job. We understand that inviting a contractor into your home requires trust. That’s why we focus on professionalism, respect for your property, clear communication, careful preparation, and quality workmanship from start to finish.

Every project receives daily oversight from our owner and crew leads, helping ensure the work stays on schedule, quality standards are maintained, and any questions or concerns are addressed throughout the job.

Whether you need a single bedroom refreshed, an entire home repainted, trim and doors updated, or a complete exterior transformation, Paint Wizards is ready to bring your vision to life.
